# 1 Clement Chapter 12 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 12 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_012_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 12

**12:1** Because of her faith and hospitality Rahab the harlot was saved. [Josh 2; 6]

**12:2** For when the scouts were sent to Jericho by Joshua the son of Nun, the king of the land realized that they had come to reconnoiter his country, and sent men to seize them in order to put them to death.

**12:3** But the hospitable Rahab took them in and concealed them under the flax stalks on the roof.

**12:4** And when the king's envoys arrived and said, "The men who came to spy out our land came in to you; bring them out, for the king so orders," she answered: "The two men whom you seek departed from me and went away" — and she directed them on a different road.

**12:5** And she said to the men: "I know full well that the Lord your God is handing this city over to you, for terror of you has fallen upon all who dwell in it. When therefore you take it, keep me and my father's household safe."

**12:6** And they said to her: "It shall be exactly as you have spoken to us. When you see us coming, you shall gather all your household under your roof, and they will be kept safe; but whoever is found outside your house shall perish."

**12:7** And in addition they gave her a sign: she was to hang a length of scarlet thread from her house — thereby showing that through the blood of the Lord redemption would come to all who believe and hope in God.

---

*LOGOS formal equivalence.*
